title: Mercurius-Baumbank (Version 1.1) — LAUDATIO repository
notes: The Mercurius-Baumbank (version 1.1), edited by Ulrike Demske (University of Potsdam), is a syntactically annotated treebank of early German newspaper (Relation) texts of the 17th century, deposited in the LAUDATIO repository (HU Berlin). The texts are distributed as TIGER-XML, NEGRA and relANNIS; the TEI files in LAUDATIO carry metadata only. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.06 (texts harvested from this edition, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
institution: Ulrike Demske, Professur Geschichte und Variation der deutschen Sprache, Universität Potsdam; hosted in the LAUDATIO repository (Humboldt-Universität zu Berlin)
